CHANGE PARTS AND SETTINGS PER CONTAINER (mm [in])
1. Elevation of pack line A looking north, true scale 1:40. Conveyor top 914 mm [36 in] for every machine.
2. Machine heights: documented where the maker publishes them (CP-404, LB-406), others estimates until OEM GA drawings.
3. CE-411 (dashed) sits behind the cobot cell and feeds open cases south into CK-412.
4. PL-415 palletizer and SW-416 wrapper are south of the line in the case & pallet area (LAY-001).
5. Every machine's own guarding stays; the line adds e-stops ES-626 every <= 10 m and a safety reset per zone.
6. Container drawn: shaker-250 (66 x 109 mm) at 260 mm pitch, 80 upm = 20.8 m/min [68 ft/min] < 72 ft/min conveyor.
